scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @soteria-forge/shared && npm run db:start && concurrently -n lms,api,console -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @soteria-forge/lms" "npm run dev --workspace @soteria-forge/api" "npm run dev --workspace @soteria-forge/console"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @soteria-forge/shared && npm run build --workspace @soteria-forge/lms && npm run build --workspace @soteria-forge/console && npm run build --workspace @soteria-forge/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @soteria-forge/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @soteria-forge/lms && npm run typecheck --workspace @soteria-forge/console && npm run typecheck --workspace @soteria-forge/api
